verdict.rationale: The Scribe docs state per-model language coverage: ten languages on zoom-scribe-multilingual, 26 more locales on the whisper model, and a separate English-only Pro model (zoom-scribe-en-pro). The evidence gives only counts, though, not the actual languages or locales. Per-feature differences are only hinted at, e.g. the profanity filter applies 'when supported by the selected model'. missing for 10: an evidenced concrete list of language/locale names, an explicit per-feature support matrix (e.g. diarization, language detection or custom vocabulary by language), independent corroboration.
